name: Spicy Pork Noodles
summary: Ground pork and spaghetti tossed in a garlicky soy and sesame sauce with chili flakes and green onion.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until just al dente. Reserve 125 mL of pasta water before draining.
Heat vegetable oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground pork and cook, breaking apart, until browned — about 7 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and chili flakes. Stir and cook 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, and 4 tbsp of the reserved pasta water in a small bowl. Pour into the skillet.
Add drained noodles and toss everything together over medium heat 2 minutes until the sauce coats the noodles.
Remove from heat. Drizzle with sesame oil and toss again.
Divide into bowls and top with sliced green onions.

substitutions.costNote: Rice noodles run $2–4 per package; likely adds $1–2.

glutenFree.notes: Use rice noodles and tamari for a gluten-free version.

budgetNotes: Ground pork (club pack) at No Frills is $11.00/kg. At 300g it costs $3.30 and feeds four people.
This is one of the cheapest recipes on the site at $1.49 per serving. It happens because pork is cheap and spaghetti is cheap.
The chili level here is adjustable. The recipe as written is medium — reduce to a pinch for milder heat.
